joints.handle_description: Round knob (~24 mm, protrudes ~17 mm) high on the right door near its free centre edge; hinge on the outer right edge.
Round knob (~24 mm, protrudes ~17 mm) high on the left door near its free centre edge; hinge on the outer left edge.
Thin horizontal bar pull (~9 mm, protrudes ~20 mm) centred on the right drawer front; A on its middle.
Thin horizontal bar pull (~9 mm, protrudes ~20 mm) centred on the left drawer front; A on its middle.

object_note: Heuristic correct on all four joints: knobs at the doors' meeting edges, bar pulls centred on both drawers. Both doors swing outward on their outer hinges.
